description: This file defines a struct 'DeviceInfos' in the PdfSharp.Forms namespace that encapsulates information about a physical device such as a display or printer, including size, resolution, DPI, and scaling factors, with a method to retrieve these details from a device context handle.

classes.name: DeviceInfos
classes.description: A struct containing device information such as size, resolution, DPI, and scale factors, with a static method to obtain device info from a device context handle.

methods.name: GetInfos
methods.description: Retrieves device information from an unmanaged device context handle and computes physical DPI and scale factors.
